title: fix(objectql): a script action's first call no longer stalls when a write inside its transaction triggers a flow
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9JpRoUZGqtwqMU5k7b4C58D)_

Fixes #36490

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:AI 助手(以及界面上的按钮)第一次运行一个在事务里写数据的脚本动作时,不再卡住 30 秒后报服务器错误,第一次就能成功;用户无需重试。
- 为什么做:属于 MCP 写入能力(AI 通过动作办事)这条主线;差旅报销的每日评测连续两天发现"第一次调用失败、原样重试成功",AI 因此会重试或绕路直写,曾留下重复报销单。
- 出错会怎样:改动只影响沙箱脚本里开启的事务;若有问题,表现是该类动作的写入与预期不一致,撤回本次合并即可恢复原状。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

Root cause, measured on the published 18.6.0 server with the `travel_expense` fixture (`--template docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json`, unmanaged install, an employee persona over `/api/v1/mcp`):

- The first `run_action demotravel_file_expense_claim` (with or without `objectName`) took 30.3 s and answered `INTERNAL_ERROR` 500; the next two identical calls answered `ok` in under a second. Server log of the first call: `exceeded wall-clock ceiling of 30000ms while awaiting host calls`.
- The action body writes inside `ctx.api.transaction(...)`. That runs on `ScopedContext`'s begin/commit/rollback trio, whose handle is threaded explicitly and was never published to the engine's ambient transaction store (a declared limit on `ObjectQL.beginTransaction`).
- The first claim line's roll-up updated the claim, which fired the record-triggered flows on `demotravel_expense_claim`. The flow run's setup (`resolveRunContext` → the automation plugin's tenant currency resolver → `resolveLocalizationContext`) read `sys_platform_setting` / `sys_setting` through the engine with no handle. On SQLite's single-connection pool that read waited for the connection the body's transaction held, until the sandbox wall clock rolled the transaction back. The read then completed and was cached, so the retry passed. A stack trace taken on that read is in the Verification section.
- So neither PM hypothesis held as stated: not a cold sandbox (the body's writes ran in about 1 s) and not a registration race (the action was found and admitted on every call). It is an ADR-0034 D1 violation: an internal read issued while a transaction is open did not run on the transaction's connection.

The fix (`packages/objectql/src/engine-middleware-and-context.ts`): `executeWithMiddleware` now runs an operation whose context carries an OPEN trio handle with that handle published in the ambient store for the operation's duration. The entry has `runOpenedUnit`'s shape (the trio's scope for the same-origin gate, its commit queue for `async` after-hooks) and is emptied when the operation settles. Not published for a run detached from the handle, nor over a store that already carries a transaction. `unit-detach.ts` gains a getter for the trio's commit queue.

No contract change: no error code, no schema key, no public export.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-ambient-transaction.test.ts`, new top-level describe: an after-hook read with no handle runs on the trio's transaction; nothing is published between operations or after the commit; a nested `transaction()` inside the operation joins (one begin).
- `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/action-body-transaction-rollup-child.integration.test.ts`, new case in the existing harness: a real better-sqlite3 `SqlDriver`, the real QuickJS action body through the `/actions` door, the travel-expense shape, plus an `afterUpdate` hook on the parent that reads through the engine with no handle (the flow setup's read). It must answer 200 inside the 10 s bound with the lines and roll-up landed.

Readings, all at head `69c95116d`:

<details><summary>Published 18.6.0 host (before), first call vs retries</summary>

`os dev` blank host on the published 18.6.0 CLI, the fixture installed unmanaged, an employee persona over `/api/v1/mcp`, three `run_action demotravel_file_expense_claim` calls (first two without `objectName`, third with it):

```
16:09:17 run_action #1 30356ms isError=true  INTERNAL_ERROR ... timed out: it exceeded its 30000 ms time limit while waiting on platform calls
16:09:18 run_action #2   672ms isError=false
16:09:18 run_action #3   717ms isError=false
```

The same shape twice more (30237 ms, 30300 ms first call). Server log of the first call: `exceeded wall-clock ceiling of 30000ms while awaiting host calls (after N pump iterations)`. A stack trace taken on the stalled read: `resolveRunContext` (service-automation) to the tenant currency resolver to `resolveLocalizationContext` (core) to an engine `find` on the settings objects with no transaction handle.

The same host with this fix's shape patched into its objectql dist: first call `ok` in 1321 ms (first call without `objectName`) and 1095 ms (first call with it).
</details>

<details><summary>This branch, booted host (examples/app-todo on the built tree)</summary>

Fix in dist:

```
run_action #1  439ms isError=false   (no objectName; answer carries "objectName": "demotravel_expense_claim")
run_action #2  590ms isError=false
run_action #3  514ms isError=false
```

A second boot: 292 / 425 / 497 ms, all ok.

Fix removed from the objectql dist (main's behaviour), same boot and script:

```
run_action #1 30293ms isError=true  INTERNAL_ERROR  Action 'demotravel_file_expense_claim' timed out: it exceeded its 30000 ms time limit while waiting on platform calls
run_action #2   287ms isError=false
run_action #3   304ms isError=false
```

The dist was restored afterwards and `cmp` matched the backed-up built files byte for byte.
</details>

<details><summary>Tests, ablation and restore</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/engine-ambient-transaction.test.ts`: 21 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/sandbox/action-body-transaction-rollup-child.integration.test.ts`: 3 passed, 2 skipped (the skips are the file's existing live-Postgres cases, which need OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: Test Files 629 passed (629), Tests 14293 passed (14293).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` exit 0.

Ablation (`await publishTrioHandleFor(this.txStore, ctx.context?.transaction, chain);` replaced by `await chain();` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; anchor count 0 after the mutation; objectql rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs --absent` exit 0):

- unit file: 2 failed of 21 (the after-hook read case and the nested-join case).
- integration file: the new case failed at 30068 ms with `500 INTERNAL_ERROR ... Action 'rux_file' timed out: it exceeded its 30000 ms time limit while waiting on platform calls`.

Restore: `git checkout HEAD -- FILE`, `git diff HEAD` 0 lines, blob `36188a75a8f3` equal to the HEAD blob, objectql rebuilt, the integration file green again.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `69c95116d`: 66 families, all run locally, all exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Five dist-reading families (`check:dts-closure`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`) first answered exit 3 (no build yet) and were rerun after the build closure, exit 0. `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` exit 0. `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main` exit 0 (no anchored file in the change set). Repo-wide scans and `test:repo` are left to CI.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card's day-3 `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` on a listed action did not reproduce: on 18.6.0 and with the fix, a call with `objectName` and one without both resolved and ran. Day 4 (same server) had no 404 either.
- `objectName` absent resolves the same way `list_actions` names the action (measured: answered `"objectName": "demotravel_expense_claim"`).
- On main the committed fixture `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json` no longer installs: `install-local` answers 422 `INVALID_METADATA` (`objects.demotravel_expense_claim.validations[0] [state-machine-no-initial-states]`, the same on `demotravel_approval_step`). The main-tree readings above use the fixture with its three `state_machine` validations removed; nothing else changed. Reported to the seat, not changed here.
- Seen while measuring, not changed here: on a fresh `os dev` blank host from 18.6.0, every audited write logged `Audit write FAILED on sys_audit_log ... no such table`. Not measured on main.

## Verification

Read first:
1. `packages/objectql/src/engine-middleware-and-context.ts`, `publishTrioHandleFor` (the risk: which handles are published and when the entry is emptied).
2. `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/action-body-transaction-rollup-child.integration.test.ts`, the new case.
3. `packages/objectql/src/unit-detach.ts`, `trioCommitQueueOf`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/sandbox/action-body-transaction-rollup-child.integration.test.ts` shows every case passing, the new one in about 1 s.
